lodPolicy.lod1: Volumetric head/torso with continuous triangular arm lofts and crossed leg/neck ribbons; intended for medium-distance stands
lodPolicy.lod2: 24-triangle double-sided skinned silhouette for distant stands; no texture impostor

provenance.geometry: Original anatomical retopology informed by existing CC0 characters2 body and head surfaces; no copied geometry
provenance.textures: Original 256x128 painted face and garment atlas per fan, embedded in GLB
provenance.numeralGlyphs: Rasterized system DejaVu Sans Bold; font software is not included
provenance.license: CC0-1.0 for original artwork; DejaVu glyph design retains its upstream license

audio.provenance: Original deterministic procedural synthesis; no external audio samples

assets.description: Short damped inharmonic metal tick, low soft ball contact
Short alternate rim tick; no sustained bell resonance
Descending noisy cord friction with three tiny thread flicks
Damped low panel and rubber impact, no glass-shatter sample
Rubber air-cavity pitch drop, woody contact, short early reflection
Two short changing-pitch stick-slip contacts and rubber friction

inventoryRule: All delivery files except manifest.json itself; byte budget includes manifest.json too.
